brief: OpenMontage: AI-driven video production system with 12 pipelines and 100+ tools. Breakout timing: 12-18 months.
Breakout opportunities in AI agent frameworks (skills, ponytail, orca, hermes-agent) and AI-powered tools (firecrawl, video generator, UI/UX assistant).
AI gateway with 350+ providers and 1200+ models offers a unique opportunity to aggregate and monetize AI resources.
Public APIs and diagram types provide foundational resources for AI products.
DeepSeek-Harness: Modular AI plugin system for developers. Breakout timing: 6-12 months.
